records.text: Breland reported that Elephant Clipping prohibited clips of Megyn Kelly, Nick Fuentes, Tucker Carlson, Robert F. Kennedy Jr., and Riley Gaines, among others, and banned subjects including January 6 and Trump-family cryptocurrencies; the Turning Point campaign barred Candace Owens videos.
records.speaker: Ali Breland

appearances.snippet: Elephant clipping has some areas that are out of bounds for reasons that aren't made clear. Clippers are instructed not to post videos of journalist Megyn Kelly, commentators Nick Fuentes and Tucker Carlson, Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., or the anti-trans activist Riley Gaines, among others. ... Banned subjects include the January 6th, 2021 attack on the Capitol and cryptocurrencies that members of the Trump family have promoted. ... In the Turning Point USA campaign, Clippers are barred from posting videos of Candace Owens, who has become an Erika Kirk antagonist.

conveyance.original_source: The Atlantic, Inside a Conservative Operation to Hijack Your Social Media Feed, as read in the episode

records.text: Owens guessed that RFK Jr. could not be clipped because pharmaceutical interests were a big piece of the wealth involved, and said all roads seemed to run into a Las Vegas syndicate.
